# Cankal Software & IT Consultancy Ltd.

> Premium SaaS products, AI Transformation, and Next-Generation Web Development based in the United Kingdom.

## Company Overview
Cankal Software and IT Consultancy Ltd. is a UK-registered technology consultancy specializing in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Computer Vision, and modern full-stack web applications. We build high-performance software for businesses seeking AI automation, custom SaaS platforms, and enterprise-grade web development.

## Founder & Leadership (E-E-A-T)
- **Founder & Principal Architect:** Ali Cankal
- **Personal Portfolio:** [https://alicankal.com](https://alicankal.com)
- **LinkedIn:** [https://linkedin.com/company/cankal_software](https://linkedin.com/company/cankal_software)
- **Expertise:** Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Next.js / React Architecture, AI Workflow Automation, SaaS Product Engineering.

## Core Capabilities & Services
1. **AI Transformation & Automated Workflows:**
   - Transitioning manual workflows to autonomous, reliable AI pipelines.
   - AI Governance, security compliance, and safe multimodal AI deployments.
   - Enterprise AI strategy and change management.

2. **Proprietary SaaS Solutions:**
   - **Firevision ([https://firevision.uk](https://firevision.uk)):** AI-powered computer vision fire detection and real-time monitoring.
   - **Smart Evacuation App ([https://www.firevision.uk/evacuation-app](https://www.firevision.uk/evacuation-app)):** Dynamic evacuation routing and emergency facility safety.
   - **Forex Predictive Analytics:** Machine learning models for market trend analysis.

3. **Bespoke Full-Stack Web Development:**
   - Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Cloud native backends (Convex, Node.js, Python).
   - High-converting, aesthetic web design with sub-second performance.
   - Custom CRM, ERP, and healthcare/therapy operating platforms (e.g. CBT-OS).
